name: nh_home_concept
subject: make this grey night harbour in Stockholm cosy and finished for a 7 year old. The grey box marked HOME becomes Mia's little red wooden house, front-on, with white window frames, two warmly lit yellow windows, a green front door with a lantern beside it and a small porch step, without letters; the grey ground becomes a granite quay of big cut stones; the dotted white light rings become soft warm amber lamp light drawn as two or three flat stepped pools, no dots; behind, dark blue harbour sheds, boats on moorings with little lights and the old town on the far shore with a few lit windows under the moon; the sky deep blue with stars

slot.file: riverwalk/levelart/night.lua (quay, Mia house, light model, backdrop)
slot.where: Night Harbour, the end at Mia home, camera x 4160
